disclaimer: Estimates only. Actual bank terms, rates and rules (including Nepal Rastra Bank limits) may differ.

categories.name: Home Loan
categories.description: Long-term secured financing (5-30 years, 60-80% LTV) for buying, constructing, renovating, topping up, or refinancing residential property.

variants.name: Fixed Rate
variants.howItWorks: Your interest rate remains locked for the entire tenure, keeping every monthly EMI identical regardless of central bank rate movements.
variants.bestFor: Borrowers who prioritize strict monthly budget predictability and expect market rates to rise.

variants.name: Floating (Variable)
variants.howItWorks: Linked to a bank benchmark/base rate plus spread. When rates change, your tenure or EMI adjusts automatically. Prepayments are typically penalty-free.
variants.bestFor: Long-term home buyers planning periodic prepayments or expecting stable/falling rates.

variants.name: Hybrid (Fixed 2-5 yrs, then Floating)
variants.howItWorks: Starts with a fixed rate for the first 2 to 5 years for early certainty, then automatically converts to a floating rate for the remaining tenure.
variants.bestFor: New homeowners who want early cash-flow stability during furnishing/move-in years.

variants.name: Standard Level EMI
variants.howItWorks: Equal monthly installments throughout the loan. Early payments go mostly to interest; later payments reduce principal faster.
variants.bestFor: Salaried borrowers with steady, predictable monthly income.

variants.name: Step-Up EMI
variants.howItWorks: Begins with a lower initial EMI that steps up by a fixed percentage every 12-24 months, matching expected salary growth and shortening total tenure.
variants.bestFor: Early-career professionals expecting regular income increments who want higher eligibility today.

variants.name: Step-Down EMI
variants.howItWorks: Higher EMIs in the early years that step down periodically, front-loading principal reduction and cutting lifetime interest.
variants.bestFor: Borrowers nearing retirement or expecting higher future household expenses.

variants.name: Overdraft / Offset
variants.howItWorks: Linked savings/overdraft account where parked cash is subtracted from your principal when computing interest, while staying liquid.
variants.bestFor: Business owners or high-savings households who hold surplus cash buffers.

variants.name: Full Disbursement
variants.howItWorks: 100% of the sanctioned loan is released upfront (typical for ready-to-move properties) and full EMIs begin immediately.
variants.bestFor: Ready-to-move apartments and resale home purchases.

variants.name: Tranche + Pre-EMI
variants.howItWorks: Loan is released in construction-linked stages. You pay interest-only (Pre-EMI) on the disbursed amount during construction, then full EMI after handover.
variants.bestFor: Under-construction homes or self-construction projects where you are also paying rent.

variants.name: Purchase / Construction
variants.howItWorks: Primary mortgage for acquiring a ready home, plot plus construction, or building on owned land within LTV limits (60-80%).
variants.bestFor: First-time or upgrade homebuyers.

variants.name: Renovation / Extension
variants.howItWorks: Funds structural remodeling, extra floors, or upgrades against existing home equity, usually with shorter tenure.
variants.bestFor: Existing homeowners upgrading or expanding living space.

variants.name: Top-Up Loan
variants.howItWorks: Additional borrowing on top of your existing home loan after a clean repayment track record, giving a combined blended EMI at mortgage rates.
variants.bestFor: Existing home loan holders needing extra funds cheaper than a personal loan.

variants.name: Balance Transfer
variants.howItWorks: Move your remaining loan balance to a new lender offering a lower rate; weigh processing/transfer fees against monthly savings to find break-even.
variants.bestFor: Borrowers paying 0.75%+ above current market rates with 5+ years left.

variants.name: LTV / Down Payment
variants.howItWorks: Auto-computes Loan-to-Value (60-80% cap) and required upfront down payment (20-40%) from the property valuation.
variants.bestFor: Buyers budgeting upfront cash alongside monthly mortgage EMIs.

variants.name: Prepayment / Foreclosure
variants.howItWorks: Part-payments or early closure are penalty-free on floating home loans and typically carry an editable 2% fee on fixed-rate loans.
variants.bestFor: Borrowers planning annual bonus prepayments to cut years off tenure.

variants.name: Moratorium Period (6-12m)
variants.howItWorks: Principal repayment is paused for 6-12 months during initial occupancy or grace window while interest is paid monthly or capitalized.
variants.bestFor: Borrowers needing initial cash-flow breathing room.

variants.name: Loan Protection Insurance
variants.howItWorks: Includes credit life / mortgage protection cover premium in your effective total borrowing cost.
variants.bestFor: Single-income households wanting mortgage liability protection.

categories.name: Personal Loan
categories.description: Fast, unsecured multi-purpose borrowing (1-7 years) with reducing vs flat rate comparison and flexi credit-line options.

variants.name: Standard Term Loan
variants.howItWorks: Fixed lump sum credited upfront and repaid in equal monthly EMIs over 1 to 7 years with no collateral.
variants.bestFor: One-time known expenses like debt consolidation or weddings.

variants.name: Flexi / Line of Credit
variants.howItWorks: Approved credit limit where you withdraw and repay freely; interest is charged ONLY on the used amount.
variants.bestFor: Irregular cash needs where you want to draw only what you use and repay early.

variants.name: Overdraft Facility
variants.howItWorks: Revolving credit line linked to your salary or savings account. Depositing cash immediately lowers interest-bearing balance.
variants.bestFor: Salaried professionals needing an emergency standby liquidity line.

variants.name: Pre-Approved / Instant
variants.howItWorks: Fast-track digital disbursement for existing bank customers with minimal paperwork, typically carrying slightly higher processing fees.
variants.bestFor: Urgent short-term funding needs requiring same-day disbursal.

variants.name: Reducing Balance Rate
variants.howItWorks: Interest is computed each month only on the remaining unpaid principal, steadily decreasing interest outgo over time.
variants.bestFor: Transparent bank personal loans — always compare offers on reducing basis.

variants.name: Flat Rate vs Reducing Balance
variants.howItWorks: Flat rate charges interest on the FULL original principal every month regardless of repayments — shows both side-by-side plus extra interest cost and effective annual rate.
variants.bestFor: Spotting hidden cost when a lender quotes an attractively low 'flat' rate.

categories.name: Auto / Vehicle Loan
categories.description: Secured vehicle financing (3-7 years) with editable EV vs Fuel LTV caps (Nepal Rastra Bank rules), balloon options, and NOC hypothecation checklist.
checklistItems: Confirm final EMI cleared and zero balance statement issued
Request Bank Hypothecation Release NOC letter (Form 35 / Bank NOC)
Collect original RC/Bluebook & remove hypothecation endorsement on insurance
Submit NOC at Transport Office (RTO / DOTM) to release vehicle hypothecation

variants.name: Standard Amortizing
variants.howItWorks: Fixed monthly EMIs fully amortize your vehicle loan to zero by the end of 3 to 7 years.
variants.bestFor: Buyers planning to keep the car long-term and own it outright.

variants.name: Balloon Payment
variants.howItWorks: Enjoy 20-35% lower monthly EMIs during the tenure by deferring a large lump sum (balloon) to the final month.
variants.bestFor: Drivers who upgrade cars every 3-5 years or expect a future bonus/resale payout.

variants.name: Step-Up / Step-Down EMI
variants.howItWorks: Start with lower EMIs that scale up annually (or higher early EMIs that taper down) to fit your income trajectory.
variants.bestFor: Young professionals buying their first vehicle with rising income.

variants.name: Zero / Low Down Payment (80-100%)
variants.howItWorks: High financing up to 80-100% of on-road price, preserving upfront cash at the expense of higher monthly EMI and interest.
variants.bestFor: Buyers who prefer keeping liquid savings invested rather than paying heavy down payment.

variants.name: Electric Vehicle (EV)
variants.howItWorks: Favorable EV financing LTV cap (up to 80% per Nepal Rastra Bank rules, editable in catalog) and lower green-mobility interest rates.
variants.bestFor: EV buyers seeking lower down payment (20%) and preferential interest rates.

variants.name: Fuel (Petrol / Diesel)
variants.howItWorks: Conventional fuel vehicle financing with stricter LTV cap (50% per Nepal Rastra Bank private vehicle guideline, editable in catalog).
variants.bestFor: Conventional petrol/diesel/hybrid cars under regulatory LTV caps.

categories.name: Education Loan
categories.description: Higher-study financing featuring study + 6-12m moratorium, simple vs compound interest treatment, collateral options, and semester-wise tranches.

variants.name: Simple Interest in Moratorium
variants.howItWorks: Principal is paused during study period + 6-12 months grace. Paying simple interest monthly while studying prevents capitalization and saves heavily.
variants.bestFor: Families able to service modest monthly interest during the study period.

variants.name: Compound / Capitalized Moratorium
variants.howItWorks: Zero payments while studying + 6-12 months grace, but unpaid moratorium interest gets capitalized into principal before full EMI starts.
variants.bestFor: Students with zero cash flow during university who will repay fully after graduation.

variants.name: Collateral-Backed (Property / FD)
variants.howItWorks: Backed by residential property or fixed deposit, unlocking higher loan amounts and lower interest rates.
variants.bestFor: Overseas degrees or high-tuition programs needing lower rates.

variants.name: Non-Collateral (Co-Signer)
variants.howItWorks: Approved based on university ranking and co-signer income without pledging property, usually at a higher interest rate.
variants.bestFor: Admits to top-ranked universities without pledgeable real estate.

variants.name: Direct-to-Institution Tranches
variants.howItWorks: Disbursed semester-by-semester directly to the university. Interest accrues ONLY on each disbursed tranche.
variants.bestFor: Multi-year degree programs billed per semester or academic year.

variants.name: Full Upfront Disbursement
variants.howItWorks: Single full release (e.g., GIC / blocked account + full year tuition). Interest starts accruing on the entire balance from day one.
variants.bestFor: Short 1-year postgraduate diplomas or blocked-account visa requirements.

categories.name: Business & Working Capital
categories.description: Working capital/cash credit, business term loans (1-10 years), invoice/bill discounting (30-90 days), and import LC/Trust Receipt financing.

variants.name: Working Capital / Cash Credit
variants.howItWorks: Revolving credit limit against inventory & receivables. Interest accrues daily ONLY on the utilized amount as you draw and repay.
variants.bestFor: Seasonal inventory purchases and smoothing day-to-day receivables.

variants.name: Business Term Loan (1-10 yrs)
variants.howItWorks: Structured capital loan repaid in fixed or floating EMIs over 1 to 10 years for machinery, expansion, or office build-out.
variants.bestFor: Capex investments with multi-year payback horizons.

variants.name: Invoice / Bill Discounting
variants.howItWorks: Bank advances 70-85% of your unpaid B2B invoice upfront for 30-90 days after deducting a discount fee; computes true effective annualized cost.
variants.bestFor: B2B suppliers waiting 30-90 days for corporate buyers to settle invoices.

variants.name: Letter of Credit / Trust Receipt
variants.howItWorks: Import financing where the bank settles overseas suppliers under LC and grants a defined Trust Receipt repayment window.
variants.bestFor: Importers and trading firms funding goods in transit until domestic sale.

categories.name: Loan Against Assets
categories.description: Leverage Fixed Deposits (80-90% LTV), Gold (EMI / Interest-Only / Bullet), or Shares (Margin Call monitor) for low-cost liquidity.

variants.name: Loan Against FD
variants.howItWorks: Borrow up to 80-90% of your Fixed Deposit at FD rate + 1-2% spread. Your FD keeps earning interest, showing your true net borrowing cost.
variants.bestFor: Short-to-medium liquidity without breaking an FD and paying premature penalty.

variants.name: Gold Loan — EMI
variants.howItWorks: Pledge gold ornaments/bullion up to 75% LTV and repay principal + interest smoothly via standard monthly EMIs.
variants.bestFor: Borrowers wanting disciplined monthly closure of a gold-backed loan.

variants.name: Gold Loan — Monthly Interest-Only
variants.howItWorks: Pay only monthly interest during the tenure and settle the entire principal in one lump sum at maturity.
variants.bestFor: Short-term cash-flow bridge with minimal monthly burden.

variants.name: Gold Loan — Bullet at Maturity
variants.howItWorks: Zero monthly payments during tenure. All accrued interest plus full principal are settled together in one bullet payment at maturity.
variants.bestFor: Agricultural, seasonal, or lump-sum receivable borrowers.

variants.name: Margin / Share Loan
variants.howItWorks: Borrow against demat shares within regulatory LTV cap (50-70%) with minimum margin tracking and live Margin Call alert when share value drops.
variants.bestFor: Investors leveraging equity portfolios while monitoring downside margin risk.
